notes: Customer overview: TideVector builds a live translation + context-aware assistant embedded into multiplayer titles. Strong need: sub-150ms median response for short queries, p95 under 200ms for chat snippets.

Traffic profile: peak concurrent users 12k, typical per-instance request size small (40-150 tokens) but with periodic long summaries (800-1200 tokens). Want to keep overall cloud spend constrained — target ~<$2,000/month per million messages equivalent.

Primary technical ask: evaluate batching vs micro-batching tradeoffs — they worry batching will add latency spikes during low concurrency sessions (mobile players). Interested in Redwood's continuous-batching and KV caching to accelerate repeated prompts (player state).
Quantization interest: want to benchmark int8 and mixed-precision quantized variants for 7B and 13B models. Priority: maintain response quality for translation and short instruction-following.

Benchmarking request details: run 3 experiment axes — model size (7B/13B), quantization profile (fp16/int8/q4_0), deployment mode (hosted/dedicated), sequence length buckets (30-80, 200-400, 800-1200). Measure p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput at 50/200/800 qps, and cost per 1M tokens. Provide raw traces + kernel-level perf notes.

Routing/fallback requirements: prefer smart routing by region and cost tier; want automatic fallback to smaller quantized variants if latency SLO threatened. Interested in 'graceful degradation' examples.

Security/compliance: SSO (SAML) required for console access, mandatory audit logs retention 1 year, KMS integration for key material. Regional residency: primary NA with occasional EU sessions (data residency considerations).
POC scope: 6-week POC. Week 1-2: perf benchmarks & model selection. Week 3-4: integration (SDK + streaming). Week 5: small in-game load test (staging). Week 6: ROI/cost tuning and final runbook.
Quotes / paraphrases: 'We need predictable p95 — bursts kill player experience.'; 'If quantized 13B hits quality bar, we'll prefer dedicated pools.'
Commercial notes: procurement prefers monthly commit for first 6 months, potential annual reserved capacity later. Budget owners: VP Product (A. Gomez) + CTO (L. Nguyen).

Open questions sent to SE: provide recommended batching window heuristics for mobile clients, KV cache TTL guidance for user-turn state, and expected cost delta between hosted API and Redwood Dedicated for 13B-int8 workloads.
